items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewee Bernard Steinau does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Claiborne Williams is made solely by the Interviewer to prompt the interviewee, with no personal connection or interaction described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: I even knew Freddie Landry from there, he used to play around there. Gosh, what was that band that was so famous for? Um, Dowson, you know, and... Well, it'll come to me after a while. Freddie was one of the... I guess it was Williams.

Claiborne Williams. Claiborne Williams. That's the one I'm trying to think of. Yeah. Well, anyway, so they were smaller than Don's band and... Oh, yes. Oh, yes. And was it any different going from Sidney Desdine to Don? Was it about the same kind of band?
